title: Independent scientific qualification plan for F-MR09 precomputed root-sink runtime composition

positive qrot enters the Richards residual as a sink via +qrot(i)
the reconstructed vertical flux balance subtracts qrot(i)
cumulative qrot is booked on the outgoing side of the legacy water balance

independent_equation_oracle.fixture: heterogeneous nodewise positive qrot paired with identical nodewise qssdi
independent_equation_oracle.hydraulic_expectation: because the admitted residual uses +root_sink-source, identical qrot and qssdi cancel node by node and the committed hydraulic state must equal the zero-root zero-qssdi control
independent_equation_oracle.mass_expectation: authoritative total_out delta equals sum(qrot)*DeltaT exactly once and authoritative total_in delta equals sum(qssdi)*DeltaT exactly once
independent_equation_oracle.hard_mass_expectation: accepted residual remains within 1e-12 and aggregate authoritative mass remains complete
independent_equation_oracle.transaction_expectation: A/B/A from one committed checkpoint reproduces A candidate state and authoritative mass exactly after discarding B

required_gates: heterogeneous nodewise balanced root/qssdi hydraulic cancellation
inactive nonzero root forcing fail-closed before solver
negative root forcing fail-closed before solver
